The situation escalated just a minute later when both Alarcon and Izquierdoz were shown second yellows and subsequent red cards in the 53rd minute, leaving both sides with ten men and turning the pitch into a tactical battlefield. Late Heroics and Final Whistle Chaos With more space available on the pitch, the game opened up significantly. Lanus managed to claw their way back into the contest in the 79th minute when L. In the dying moments of the game, the referee was forced into action once again. H. D. L. Fuente , who had already been cautioned in the 90+5 minute, received a second yellow card and was sent off in the 90+11 minute. To cap off an extraordinary and frenetic match, Lanus goalscorer L. Bezzosi was shown a straight red card in the 90+12 minute, leaving the visitors further depleted as the final whistle blew on a night of absolute chaos.
